name: lance_encoding::EncodingsIo::submit_request
behavior: Public EncodingsIo:Debug+Send+Sync supplies a single-file IO service without requiring lance-io. submit_request borrows self, owns Vec<Range<u64>> and u64 priority, and returns a static boxed future of Result<Vec<Bytes>>. Contract requires one returned Bytes per requested range even after coalescing, and an empty buffer for each empty range. Priority should be the lowest row delivered so late indirect reads can be prioritized. Trait declaration does not enforce range legality, response ordering/count, scheduling, cancellation or durability; implementations/callers own those obligations.

name: lance_encoding::EncodingsIo::submit_single

Correct one-response implementations return their sole Bytes.

name: lance_encoding::<BufferScheduler as EncodingsIo>::submit_request
behavior: BufferScheduler submit_request consumes ranges in input order, eagerly slices and collects a Vec before constructing future::ready(Ok(...)). Therefore slicing failure occurs at submission, not first future poll. Priority is ignored; empty input returns an empty Vec; valid empty ranges produce empty slices. Returned static future owns collected Bytes, so it does not borrow self. No IO, backpressure, task spawn, cancellation handling, coalescing, stats override or local tests exist; bypass/stats inherit None. Dropping a returned future releases its results, but cannot undo already performed slicing/collection.
